name: Dirk van de Berg
bio:
Dirk's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood visits to the Zandvoort Circuit, sparking a lifelong fascination with the sport's blend of technology and adrenaline. After graduating with a degree in communications, he interned at a local racing team before landing a role at United Autosports. Dirk sees his role as more than just managing public perception; he's a storyteller, crafting narratives that capture the essence of the team's spirit and achievements. His meticulous approach and keen understanding of both the technical and human aspects of motorsport make him a valuable asset to the team.

Dirk is particularly adept at building relationships with media outlets and crafting compelling press releases that cut through the noise. He believes in transparency and honesty, ensuring that the team's message resonates authentically with fans and sponsors alike. His dedication extends beyond the track, as he actively engages with the online community, fostering a sense of connection and excitement around United Autosports.

What sets Dirk apart is his perfectionist nature. He believes every detail matters in creating a positive image and managing the team's reputation. His relentless pursuit of excellence ensures that United Autosports' story is always told in the most compelling and impactful way possible.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the side with a slight wave.
physical.description: Dirk is of average height with a lean build and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using a vintage typewriter for drafting initial press releases.
Always carries a small notebook filled with story ideas and potential headlines.
Has a peculiar habit of polishing his glasses excessively when under pressure.
